index.title: Welcome to Quartz 5
index.content:
Quartz is a fast, batteries-included static-site generator that transforms Markdown content into fully functional websites. Thousands of students, developers, and teachers publish personal notes, wikis, and digital gardens to the web.
See the official documentation for more details.
